separation_policy.geometry_based: Official SFMTA asset points and curb-zone linework, plus future field-measured meshes; kept out of inferred arrays.
separation_policy.inferred: OSM tags and point/way anchors; useful for visualization but not measured geometry.

sources.geometry_basis: osm node coordinate or way centroid

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA sign shop assets manually added and updated via Sign Shop Web Map Editor.
sources.name: MTA.signs

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA stop-sign inventory manually updated from MTAB resolutions.
sources.name: MTA.stopsigns

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA traffic signal, flasher, and related-equipment inventory.
sources.name: MTA.signals

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA Digital Curb policy linework by block face.
sources.name: MTA.curb_zones_all_policies

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA Color Curb Program asset points as published in the Parking service.
sources.name: MTA.colorcurb
Parking Meters (SFMTA)
sources.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License
sources.methodology: On-street meters in service (active flag M); one record per post or pay station.

sources.name: Mapillary map features
sources.methodology: Utility poles and parking meters Mapillary placed from several detections; not seen since 2018 dropped; within 4 m of a mapped pole (8 m of a meter) dropped.

sources.name: Wireless Service Facility Permits (SF Public Works)
sources.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License
sources.methodology: Approved and active permits; one small cell per position.

sources.name: SFPUC Streetlights (San Francisco Public Utilities Commission)
sources.license: City and County of San Francisco public map layer (no licence stated)
sources.methodology: Active SFPUC-owned streetlights with their pole type. Height, arm and luminaire per pole type from the SFPUC Streetlight Catalog (2022-02); traffic-signal, wall and ceiling mounts not drawn as poles. Mapillary poles within 6 m of one dropped as the same pole.

inferred_shelter_mesh.note: SFMTA source verifies stop types and amenities, but does not publish shelter dimensions on that page.

summary.storage_note: Street furniture is published as a lazy sidecar and is not embedded in sf-corridor-3d.json.
